overview: The Void-Fracture Sanctum is the apex of Shadow Valley’s corruption and Akhevan design.
history: Akhevan high ritualists selected the deepest fracture as their sanctum.
Resonance pylons and conduits were reoriented to feed the inner rift.
Void entities began to manifest in stable forms within the sanctum.
Praesertum directives reshaped the sanctum into a strategic locus.
The sanctum became the decisive battleground of Terror of Luclin’s shadow war.
hooks: A final ritual threatens to tear Shadow Valley open.
Void entities gather around a central fracture core.
Praesertum high agents arrive to oversee the sanctum.
A resonance cascade begins to destabilize the entire valley.
